entries.name: Rusty Blade
entries.flavor: It has opened more graves than throats.

entries.name: Chipped Hatchet
entries.flavor: Someone split firewood with it until the wood fought back.

entries.name: Bone Shiv
entries.flavor: Ground from a femur, aimed at the same.

entries.name: Iron Mace
entries.flavor: Ugly, heavy, honest. It never misses twice.

entries.name: Serrated Falchion
entries.flavor: Every notch is a signature.

entries.name: Lantern Flail
entries.flavor: The keeper's light, rehung as a morning star.

entries.name: Venom Dirk
entries.flavor: That green on the edge is not rust.

entries.name: Ember Club
entries.flavor: The Warrens cook their dead with this first.

entries.name: Steel Glaive
entries.flavor: Reach is its own kind of armour.

entries.name: Wraithfang
entries.flavor: Cold enough to drink the warmth from a wound.

entries.name: Magma Warhammer
entries.flavor: Still warm. Nobody remembers who quenched it.

entries.name: Vault Cleaver
entries.flavor: Built to open waterlogged doors, and things behind them.

entries.name: Keeper's Edge
entries.flavor: The Lantern-Keepers forged it to end what they sealed.

entries.name: Soul Reaver
entries.flavor: It takes a little of everything it kills.

entries.name: Drowned Maul
entries.flavor: Pulled from the Vaults, bleeding brine that never dries.

entries.name: Torn Leather Cap
entries.flavor: Better than a bare skull. Barely.

entries.name: Cracked Buckler
entries.flavor: It has already taken the hit it was made for.

entries.name: Rag Wraps
entries.flavor: Somebody's burial clothes, doing a second shift.

entries.name: Iron Helm
entries.flavor: Standard issue for the city that drowned.

entries.name: Studded Jerkin
entries.flavor: The studs are old nails. The nails are older than the jacket.

entries.name: Oak Shield
entries.flavor: Solid as a headstone, and about as quick.

entries.name: Bone Plate
entries.flavor: Wearing the catacombs, so they cannot wear you.

entries.name: Ring Mail
entries.flavor: A thousand little rings, each one a promise.

entries.name: Ember Visor
entries.flavor: The glass is blackened, which is how you know it works.

entries.name: Warden Carapace
entries.flavor: Grown, not forged. The Warden no longer needed it.

entries.name: Magma Cuirass
entries.flavor: Warm against the chest, like a second heartbeat.

entries.name: Drownscale Mail
entries.flavor: The scales still remember swimming.

entries.name: Keeper's Bulwark
entries.flavor: The last Keeper died standing behind it.

entries.name: Vaelmoor Aegis
entries.flavor: The city itself, folded down to something a body can wear.

entries.name: Soulforged Plate
entries.flavor: The souls in it lean toward a fight.

entries.name: Lucky Coin
entries.flavor: Heads you live. It has never come up tails.

entries.name: Tin Ring
entries.flavor: A promise ring, from someone who did not come back.

entries.name: Rat Tooth Charm
entries.flavor: Smells of the warrens. Keeps the small things away.

entries.name: Garnet Ring
entries.flavor: The stone is set badly and worth more than the hand.

entries.name: Etched Amulet
entries.flavor: The etching is a prayer, or a warning, or both.

entries.name: Hunter's Token
entries.flavor: Given to those who go first into the dark.

entries.name: Rusted Censer
entries.flavor: It still smokes, though nothing has burned in it for years.

entries.name: Luckstone
entries.flavor: Warm in the pocket, heavier than it should be.

entries.name: Cinder Talisman
entries.flavor: The Warrens give it to their young before the first descent.

entries.name: Seer's Lens
entries.flavor: Look through it and the weak points glow.

entries.name: Sigil of Warding
entries.flavor: One of the seven seals. Four are still missing.

entries.name: Abyssal Band
entries.flavor: Cold, always cold, no matter whose finger it is on.

entries.name: Phoenix Feather
entries.flavor: No phoenix was harmed. It fell off.

entries.name: Void Lantern
entries.flavor: It lights nothing, and everything nearby is easier to find.

entries.name: Crown of Depths
entries.flavor: The drowned king still wears the original.

entries.name: Soul Prism
entries.flavor: Death passes through it and comes out thinner.

entries.name: Keeper's Signet
entries.flavor: Press the seal to a door and the door remembers who you are.

entries.name: Health Vial
entries.flavor: Cracked glass, thicker blood. Drink before the next room decides.

entries.name: Small Health Draught
entries.flavor: Tastes of iron and mint. Mostly iron.

entries.name: Swift Tonic
entries.flavor: Your knees will complain later. Later.

entries.name: Whetstone Salve
entries.flavor: Whet your edge, or someone else's opinion of it.

entries.name: Pilgrim Bandage
entries.flavor: Already used twice. Folded carefully anyway.

entries.name: Lantern Oil
entries.flavor: A mouthful of it and the world moves faster.

entries.name: Health Draught
entries.flavor: Standard Keeper ration, cut with something sweeter.

entries.name: Iron Skin Brew
entries.flavor: Your skin hardens. Your joints file a complaint.

entries.name: Focus Tea
entries.flavor: Brewed from the roots that grow where nobody walks.

entries.name: Greater Draught
entries.flavor: Thick as tar, and it works like it.

entries.name: Ember Tonic
entries.flavor: Bottled fire, with the lid still on.

entries.name: Hunter's Elixir
entries.flavor: Everything looks like loot for a little while.

entries.name: Vault Elixir
entries.flavor: Distilled from water that has drowned better people.

entries.name: Lava Ward Potion
entries.flavor: Drink before the Warrens, never inside them.

entries.name: Assassin Draught
entries.flavor: One breath. One window. That is the whole recipe.

entries.name: Keeper's Draught
entries.flavor: The last thing the last Keeper drank. It did not save him.

entries.name: Dragonsblood Flask
entries.flavor: No dragon was consulted.

entries.name: Soulfire Tonic
entries.flavor: It burns going down and keeps burning after.

entries.name: Whisper Dagger
entries.flavor: It never announces itself. Neither does the wound.

entries.name: Chain Reaver
entries.flavor: Every kill pulls the next one into reach.

entries.name: Mirror Shield
entries.flavor: It shows attackers exactly what they deserve.

entries.name: Bloodletter
entries.flavor: Every enemy bleeds out your losses.

entries.name: Death Spark
entries.flavor: When something falls, everything around it burns.

entries.name: Purifier
entries.flavor: Poison becomes power. Burn becomes breath.

entries.name: Ember Dancer Crystal
entries.flavor: You leave fire where you have been, not where you are.

entries.name: Venom Tongue
entries.flavor: Each strike poisons the room.

entries.name: Rusty Spear
entries.flavor: Bent beyond repair, still sharp enough to argue with.

entries.name: Tidal Halberd
entries.flavor: The sea gave it to you. It expects salt.

entries.name: Mussel Club
entries.flavor: Hard outside, soft inside.

entries.name: Sand Cutlass
entries.flavor: Patience and sharp rocks.

entries.name: River Sting
entries.flavor: Fast as the current.

entries.name: Deep Cutlass
entries.flavor: Forged in the abyss, tempered by pressure.

entries.name: Sea Claymore
entries.flavor: A sword that knows the tides.

entries.name: Sand Strength
entries.flavor: Packed sand, compressed.

entries.name: Coral Halberd
entries.flavor: Living coral hardened into a point.

entries.name: Brine Trident
entries.flavor: Three points for three enemies.

entries.name: Tidal Reaver
entries.flavor: It reaps what the tide brings in.

entries.name: Mire Blade
entries.flavor: A helm turned blade.

entries.name: Mud Glaive
entries.flavor: Sticky and slow, every hit lands.

entries.name: Silt Cleaver
entries.flavor: Cleaves through silt and bone.

entries.name: Abyssal Edge
entries.flavor: Drawn from the deepest trench.

entries.name: Abyssal Spear
entries.flavor: Pierces the darkness between heartbeats.

entries.name: Abyssal Star
entries.flavor: A falling star caught and sharpened.

entries.name: Abyssal Mail Blade
entries.flavor: Forged from abyssal metal.

entries.name: Toxic Halberd
entries.flavor: Coated in something that should not exist.

entries.name: Kraken's Fury
entries.flavor: Each strike pulls the ocean.

entries.name: Leviathan's Tongue
entries.flavor: The voice of the deep as steel.

entries.name: Leviathan Core
entries.flavor: A pulsing heart of the abyss.

entries.name: Leviathan Hide Blade
entries.flavor: Scales as the sharpest edge.

entries.name: Abyssal Glaive
entries.flavor: The abyss stares back.

entries.name: Mussel Plate
entries.flavor: A shell. That's all a shell is.

entries.name: Shell Cap
entries.flavor: Curled protection from a creature long dead.

entries.name: Salt Helm
entries.flavor: Crystallized brine around the skull.

entries.name: Sand Mail
entries.flavor: Gritty, scratchy, surprisingly durable.

entries.name: Sand Pendant
entries.flavor: A smooth stone on a string.

entries.name: Abyssal Mail
entries.flavor: Dark fabric that drinks the light.

entries.name: Abyssal Mail of Depths
entries.flavor: Named for the depth it was found.

entries.name: Coral Breastplate
entries.flavor: Grown, not forged. It adapts.

entries.name: Abyssal Gem
entries.flavor: A precious stone from the deep.

entries.name: Abyssal Pearl
entries.flavor: A pearl that hums with deep energy.

entries.name: Abyssal Crown
entries.flavor: A crown for those who ruled the depths.

entries.name: Mire Helm
entries.flavor: The crown of the bog.

entries.name: Ossuary Cuirass
entries.flavor: Bone and sinew woven.

entries.name: Abyssal Plate
entries.flavor: Thick enough to stop a leap.

entries.name: Silt Amulet
entries.flavor: Fine silt into protective shape.

entries.name: Abyssal Miracle
entries.flavor: A miracle from below.

entries.name: Ossuary Grand Plate
entries.flavor: The grandest bone armor.

entries.name: Abyssal Starplate
entries.flavor: Studded with captured starlight.

entries.name: Kraken Hide
entries.flavor: Tougher than any steel.

entries.name: Coral Vest
entries.flavor: Living coral that heals.

entries.name: Brine Brew
entries.flavor: Salty water with a kick.

entries.name: Brine Vial
entries.flavor: A tiny bottle of ocean.

entries.name: Brine Locket
entries.flavor: Contains a drop of brine.

entries.name: Small Shell
entries.flavor: A small, smooth shell.

entries.name: Pearl Chip
entries.flavor: A fragment of a pearl.

entries.name: Brine Gauntlets
entries.flavor: Soaked in brine for resilience.

entries.name: Brine Power
entries.flavor: The power of the tide.

entries.name: Brine Executor
entries.flavor: Delivers the final blow.

entries.name: Brine Trident Trinket
entries.flavor: A miniature trident.

entries.name: Abyssal Elixir
entries.flavor: Distilled from abyssal waters.

entries.name: Abyssal Trident
entries.flavor: The trident of the deep.

entries.name: Ossuary Fang
entries.flavor: A fang from the guardian.

entries.name: Ossuary Staff
entries.flavor: A staff of bone and shadow.

entries.name: Ossuary Revival
entries.flavor: The dead do not stay dead.

entries.name: Ossuary Plate Trinket
entries.flavor: A small piece of plate.

entries.name: Abyssal Miracle Amulet
entries.flavor: A miracle you can carry.

entries.name: Kraken Eye
entries.flavor: An eye that sees weaknesses.

entries.name: Leviathan Draught
entries.flavor: The draught of the leviathan.

entries.name: Brine Draught
entries.flavor: Not pleasant.

entries.name: Brine Brew Potion
entries.flavor: A weak tonic.

entries.name: Small Shell Potion
entries.flavor: A tiny potion in a shell.

entries.name: Sand Draught
entries.flavor: Gritty but effective.

entries.name: Sand Strength Tonic
entries.flavor: Sandy fortitude.

entries.name: Brine Elixir
entries.flavor: Stronger brine.

entries.name: Abyssal Tonic
entries.flavor: Distilled from deep waters.

entries.name: Coral Heal
entries.flavor: Coral energy restores health.

entries.name: Coral Surge
entries.flavor: A surge of coral.

entries.name: Abyssal Crown Draught
entries.flavor: Fit for a deep king.

entries.name: Ossuary Staff Draught
entries.flavor: Bone-deep restoration.

entries.name: Kraken Eye Elixir
entries.flavor: Concentrated kraken vision.

entries.name: Kraken Elixir
entries.flavor: The elixir of the kraken.

entries.name: Leviathan's Gift Draught
entries.flavor: The ultimate draught.

entries.name: Abyssal Starplate Draught
entries.flavor: The ultimate draught.

entries.name: Ember Dash Crystal
entries.flavor: Your dash leaves a trail of fire that burns enemies.

entries.name: Soul Reaper Scythe
entries.flavor: Killing an enemy spawns a temporary soul minion.

entries.name: Phase Cloak
entries.flavor: Dodging grants brief invulnerability.

entries.name: Pierce Bolt
entries.flavor: Ranged shots pierce through enemies.

entries.name: Vampiric Blade
entries.flavor: Melee kills heal you for a portion of damage dealt.

entries.name: Frost Orb
entries.flavor: Attacks have a chance to freeze enemies.

entries.name: Thunder Ring
entries.flavor: Critical strikes chain lightning.

entries.name: Shadow Cloak
entries.flavor: Move faster in the shadows.

entries.name: Golden Idol
entries.flavor: Increases gold drops from enemies.

entries.name: Bone Charm
entries.flavor: A knucklebone that remembers the hand it came from.

entries.name: Shadow Veil
entries.flavor: Drapes the wearer in darkness.

entries.name: Ember Draught
entries.flavor: Burns going down. Burns coming up too.

entries.name: Flame Fang
entries.flavor: A tooth from something that never stopped burning.

entries.name: Tide Cloak
entries.flavor: Still dripping after all these centuries.

entries.name: Tide Pearl
entries.flavor: A pearl that hums with the tide.

entries.name: Ossuary Shard
entries.flavor: A shard of bone from the Sunken Ossuary.

entries.name: Toxic Brew
entries.flavor: Smells like victory. Tastes like rot.
